## Goal

Cool the batch to its target temperature as fast as possible without ruining it.

The liquid holds less dissolved material as it cools. Supersaturation makes the seed crystals grow, and growth uses it up, so at constant temperature sigma falls back towards zero; the more crystal surface there is, the faster.
